backupPage.title: Backup and restore
backupPage.subtitle: Available on the main PC only.

create.description: Saves all of the program's data in one file. Keep the file on a USB drive or another computer so the data survives if this PC fails.
create.sameDrive: This backup is on the same drive as the program's data ({{drive}}), so it does not count as a copy outside this PC. Copy the file to a USB drive, an external disk or another partition.

restore.title: Restore from a backup
restore.description: Replaces all current data with the contents of the backup file. Before it starts, the program saves a copy of the current data automatically, and client PCs are disconnected until the restore finishes.
restore.safety: The data from before the restore is saved here:

safety.title: Backups folder on this PC
safety.description: The program keeps the daily backups (the last 14) and a copy of the data from before each restore (the last 5) in the backups folder on this PC.

status.title: Backup status
status.daily: The program saves an automatic backup once a day and keeps the last {{keep}}. The server pauses for a few seconds while it saves.
status.autoError: The last daily backup failed ({{date}}): {{message}} The program will try again later.

warning.title: We recommend keeping a backup on a USB drive or another disk
warning.never: No backup has been saved on a drive other than the program's data drive yet.
warning.since: The last backup on another drive was on {{date}}, more than {{days}} days ago.
warning.advice: If the program's data drive ({{drive}}) fails, the backups on it are lost too. Create a backup and save it on a USB drive, an external disk or another partition, or choose a folder on another drive below.

copy.title: Extra copy on a USB drive or another disk
copy.description: The program copies every daily backup to this folder and keeps the last 14 there. If the folder is not available at that time it is skipped, and the latest backup is copied once it is.
copy.copied: The latest daily backup was copied to this folder on {{date}}.
copy.unavailable: The folder is not available right now (is the USB drive plugged in?). The copy happens automatically once it is.
copy.failed: Could not copy to this folder: {{message}}
copy.waiting: The next daily backup will be copied to this folder.
copy.sameDrive: This folder is on the same drive as the program's data ({{drive}}), so it does not protect the data if that drive fails and does not count as a copy outside this PC. Choose a folder on a USB drive, an external disk or another partition.

progress.safety-backup: Saving a copy of the current data... {{done}} of {{total}}
progress.rolling-back: The restore failed; putting the previous data back...
